description: Use report_video for Highlights: generate one retained MP4 from the studies' default reports, with branded logo bookends, learning-goal chapters and their cited Quotes. Repeated requests return the saved video. No evidence selection is needed. Also supports an editable PowerPoint, an individual audio clip or a legacy audio reel ZIP from a completed/partial Hub run. Use exact evidence_ids returned by get_research_analysis highlights; presentations include all findings. Audio requires explicit export instruction. Text masking defaults on. Poll get_research_deliverable or tasks/get for Tasks clients. Private links last 15 minutes; temporary audio and presentation files expire in seven days; report videos are retained while their source remains available. Reuse the idempotency key after a timeout.

acknowledge_unredacted_audio.description: True only when the researcher has instructed you to export these recordings. Speech is not anonymized.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.
